arabic text: TERE SHEHR-E SE JAATE HAI, DAI HUMKO DUA NANA
english translation text: WE ARE LEAVING YOUR CITY, PRAY FOR US O GRANDFATHER (SAW)

arabic text: AABAD KARENGE HUM, HAY AB KARBOBALA NANA\nTERE SHEHR-E SE JAATE HAI, DAI HUMKO DUA NANA
english translation text: WE WILL MAKE KARBALA FLOURISH O GRANDFATHER (SAW), WE ARE\nLEAVING YOUR CITY, PRAY FOR US O GRANDFATHER (SAW)

arabic text: TERA DIN-E HE MUSHKIL ME, ME KAISE RAHO GAR ME,\nTIFLIN-E KOI WADA, HA TUJSE KIYA NANA
english translation text: YOUR RELIGION IS IN DANGER, HOW CAN I STAY HOME AND KEEP SILENT,\nI MADE A PROMISE WITH YOU WHEN I WAS A CHILD

arabic text: ROZE PE TERA AAKE, HAM SHAM-E JALAA TETHE\nHO AB-E KON-E MUJAWIR HAI, SUGRA KE SIWA NANA
english translation text: WE USED TO VISIT YOUR GRAVE TO PAY OUR RESPECT,\nTHERE IS NO ONE ELSE HERE TO VISIT YOU NOW APART FROM FATIMA SUGRA

arabic text: IS TARHA PARINDE BHI, MASKAN SE NAHI JAATA\nGURBAAT ME MUJA JAISE, HAI ABB JAANE PARA NANA
english translation text: EVEN THE BIRDS DON’T LEAVE THEIR HOMES,\nTHE WAY I HAVE TO LEAVE MY HOME HELPLESSLY

arabic text: BACHE HAI BOHOT CHOTA, GARMI KA ZAMAANA HAI\nPOHCHAYENGA MANZIR PAR, AB HUMKO KHUDA NANA
english translation text: THE CHILDREN ARE VERY YOUNG AND THE HEAT IS UNBEARABLE,\nONLY ALLAH (SWT) CAN HELP US REACH OUR DESTINATION

arabic text: AMAA KI LAHAD CHUTI, ROZA BHI TERA CHUTA\nUS WAKTA KALEJE PAR, KHANJAR SE CHALAA NANA
english translation text: WE HAVE HAD TO LEAVE THE GRAVE OF MY BELLOWED MOTHER AND YOU,\nIT WAS UNBEARABLY PAINFUL LIKE A DAGGER ON OUR THROATS
